verdict.rationale: Column is a nationally chartered bank offering programmatic FDIC-insured account opening via API (docs-2), with a full OpenAPI spec for SDK generation (docs-10, probe-2), and a sandbox explicitly designed for parity with production including simulated transfers (docs-13, docs-3). Community corroboration confirms hands-on signup/API testing experience (column-comm-5, column-comm-8). Missing for 10: independent third-party audit of full application-to-active-account automation and explicit confirmation of FDIC insurance status beyond docs claim.
